notes: The root context read the complete 1616-line UTF-8 full-text extraction without skipping the Summary, Memo, body, references, or the Boat.java and River.java appendix. Fresh read-only subagent contexts visually reviewed physical pages 1-8, 9-16, 17-24, and 25-26 using one byte-bounded JPEG review proxy per tool call. Every proxy was at most 450000 bytes, each visual context handled at most eight proxies, the root context received text-only reports and no images, and all 26 pages were checked for page continuity, cropping, formulas, code, diagrams, plot labels, references, and extraction losses.

The visual pass distinguished source defects from extraction and display artifacts. Rendered pages were authoritative for ceil and floor brackets, inequality signs, mean bars, Figure 1 and Figure 2 state diagrams, Figure 3 and Figure 4 axes and trend labels, and the appendix code. Confirmed source-level conflicts include the Summary versus Memo/body magic-number condition, prose versus Java schedule-axis order, prose oar-boat tie priority versus Java motor-boat priority, the unused MOVEMENT_CONSTANT field bypassed by a hard-coded +4, and non-reproducible single-run random test harnesses.
